name_en: EWLA Jigjiga office — free legal aid
name_am: የኢትዮጵያ የሴቶች ሕግ ባለሙያዎች ማኅበር (EWLA) ጅግጅጋ ቢሮ – ነፃ የሕግ ድጋፍ
source_text_original: Jijiga Kebele 03, Jijiga Sub-city … We provide free legal advice and representation to all women and girls, ensuring equitable access to justice across both development and crisis-affected environments.

additional_sources.name: EWLA — Annual Report 2023 (published June 2024)
additional_sources.note: "has opened its regional offices in seven regions and one city administration namely Adama, Hawassa, Bahir Dar, Gambella, Asosa, Jigjiiga, Semera regions and city administration of Dire Dawa."

notes_en: For women and girls. Hours are not stated. No phone number is published for this office; call the 7711 hotline. The source gives the town only; the region (Somali) was added for filtering.
notes_am: ለሴቶችና ልጃገረዶች። የሥራ ሰዓት አልተገለጸም። ለዚህ ቢሮ ስልክ ቁጥር አልተገለጸም፤ ወደ 7711 ይደውሉ። ምንጩ ከተማውን ብቻ ይጠቅሳል፤ ክልሉ (ሶማሌ) ለማጣሪያ ተጨምሯል።
